ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 85% high-intensity (white) to 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous field across both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated at the trailing edge margins, the central peduncle junction, and two symmetrical focal spots located in the approximate center of each lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/5th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible at both distal tips. The central trailing edge segments exhibit a lower-frequency, irregular stippled boundary where white field meets black pigmentation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to sharp, jagged distal tips; leading edge (lower boundary) shows a smooth convex sweep toward the peduncle.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-density clusters of irregular white/grey pixel blobs (consistent with barnacle colonization) located on the distal ends of both left and right tips. Two distinct, isolated circular dark spots are present in the mid-lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct linear pixel disruptions: one vertical scratch on the mid-left lobe, one diagonal scratch on the upper-left lobe, and one faint diagonal mark on the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular chipping and jagged erosion of the trailing edge topography, particularly prominent on the left distal tip, suggesting previous physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical pair of circular dark-pigmented 'target' marks, one positioned centrally on each fluke lobe.
